thread:
lucas: Hey team — noticed invoice total for Feb doesn't match the dashboard. Dashboard export sums to 112,345 tokens but invoice line items add up to 128,120. Can someone take a quick look?

lucas: attaching a tiny excerpt from the dashboard export:
```
date,tokens
2026-02-01,4321
2026-02-18,14500
2026-02-19,13000
...
total,112345
```

jen (Support): Thanks — can you paste the invoice id and customer id? Also confirm if they changed plans mid-month.

lucas: customer_id=CUST-442, invoice_id=inv-2026-02-28-442. They upgraded from "starter" -> "growth" on 2026-02-18 around 09:13 UTC. Dashboard shows the upgrade and a pro-rated credit.

tom (Finance): tagging @ravi — from finance side the invoice shows an extra line `overage_tiered: 15000 tokens`. That matches the delta, but why would dashboard not include it? Any delayed jobs?

billing-bot: invoice generated: id=inv-2026-02-28-442 total_tokens=128120 adjustments=+15000 credits=0

ravi (Eng): looking into the usage aggregation. Can you paste the raw usage export from internal storage? suspect streaming sessions might have been double-counted earlier in the month.

lucas: pasted link to internal export (redacted): https://redwood/internal/exports/442/feb.csv . Quick grep shows lots of streaming lines with both `tokens_sent` and `tokens_received` fields.

lucas: example snippet from export:
```
session,stream.recv,tokens_received,stream.send,tokens_sent
sess-1,stream.recv,120,stream.send,120
sess-2,stream.recv,300,stream.send,300
...
```

ravi (Eng): aha — our meter job before 2026-02-19 was summing `tokens_received + tokens_sent` for streaming sessions. For streaming API we should only meter outgoing/generated tokens (`tokens_sent`). That would inflate the monthly token total roughly by the amount you're seeing (~15k).

maya (CS): also: the dashboard UI applies plan-tier pricing and pro-rated credits at display time from the account state (it shows the post-upgrade view). The billing pipeline computes line items from raw aggregated usage buckets and then applies pricing rules; because the meter bug affected raw usage upstream, the invoice reflects the inflated raw counts while the dashboard shows the corrected/pro-rated UI state. That explains both the absolute token delta and the plan-tier discrepancy.

jen (Support): Proposed remediation steps: 1) Finance to prepare credit memo for the duplicated tokens between 2026-02-01 and 2026-02-19 (~15k tokens). 2) Eng to patch the meter job and run a backfill to correct stored usage buckets. 3) CS to notify the customer with explanation and expected timeline. @tom @ravi please confirm ETA.

tom (Finance): will draft the credit memo today once we get a final corrected token total from eng.

ravi (Eng): PR opened to fix summing logic, backfill job scheduled to run tonight (est 6 hours). I will post the corrected total here when done.

jen (Support): thanks all. lucas — please set customer expectation that we'll issue a credit and follow up when backfill completes. If they escalate before then, escalate to finance with this thread. :thumbsup:

lucas: appreciated. I’ll hold off on escalation until we have the credit memo.
